map.生产方风险和使用方风险分别是什么？: What are producer's risk and consumer's risk?
map.生产方风险 α 是把质量合格的批（不合格品率 ≤ AQL）误判为不合格的概率，损: Producer's risk α is the probability of wrongly rejecting a conforming lot (nonconformity ≤ AQL), harming the supplier; consumer's risk β is the probability of wrongly accepting a defective lot (nonconformity ≥ LTPD), harming the buyer. A standard sampling plan aims to keep α around 5% and β around 10%; this tool computes exactly at these two points.
map.为什么二项分布就够了，不用超几何分布？: Why is the binomial enough—why not the hypergeometric?
map.当批量 N 远大于样本量 n（一般 n/N < 0.1）时，不放回抽样可用二项分: When lot size N is far larger than sample n (usually n/N < 0.1), sampling without replacement is well approximated by the binomial with negligible error. The tool's default example n/N = 80/1000 = 8%, so the approximation holds. If N is small (e.g. N=50, n=20), use the hypergeometric instead, or the acceptance probability is overestimated. For formal plans follow GB/T 2828.1 transfer rules and sampling tables.
